question: The war that spread beyond Southern India and into Bengal, where British forces under Robert Clive recaptured Calcutta from Nawab Sirajud-Daulah, who had the support of French, was ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Battle of Plassey in 1757**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Battle of Plassey was fought between the **East India Company headed by Robert Clive **and the** Nawab of Bengal Siraj-Ud-Daulah**.
